s01-01-story-c2f468.wav.text: To understand it, you have to go back to the very beginning.

s01-02-story-170368.wav.text: In the garden, God brings the first man and the first woman together.

s01-03-grave-eb195e.wav.text: Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife.

s01-04-talk-a199c9.wav.text: Hold fast, like two cords tied in one knot.

s01-05-talk-d4d14f.wav.text: Marriage isn't a feeling that comes and goes.

s02-01-talk-2ca69a.wav.text: So the seventh commandment protects that promise.

s02-02-story-629386.wav.text: It's like a wall around a home. Think of a family.

s02-03-story-b81b42.wav.text: A mom and a dad who promised to stay.

s02-04-story-3abc4f.wav.text: Children who sleep safe, because the promise holds.

s02-05-talk-af7413.wav.text: When a promise like that breaks, everyone in the house feels it.

s03-01-talk-223b73.wav.text: God didn't just give this rule.

s03-03-story-87dc68.wav.text: All through the Bible, God makes promises to his people, and he keeps every one.

s03-04-grave-94d5e6.wav.text: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God, the faithful God who keeps covenant and steadfast love.

s04-03-story-d14694.wav.text: So the prophets used a surprising picture.

s04-04-story-e468f4.wav.text: They said Israel was like a wife who broke her promise.

s04-05-story-76c057.wav.text: God even asked the prophet Hosea to live out that picture.

s04-06-story-33d241.wav.text: His wife left him, and God told him to go and bring her home.

s04-07-talk-d098d8.wav.text: Christians have long read this as the heart of the story.

s04-08-story-1a2fe7.wav.text: Our unfaithfulness doesn't cancel God's faithfulness.

s04-09-grave-78d7e9.wav.text: I will betroth you to me in faithfulness.

s04-10-grave-4cda57.wav.text: And you shall know the LORD.

s05-02-story-45316f.wav.text: And he went deeper than anyone expected.

s05-03-grave-21175a.wav.text: You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery.’

s05-04-talk-e0cb22.wav.text: Then he said it begins long before anything happens.

s05-06-talk-1e2a6b.wav.text: Faithfulness isn't only what your hands do.

s05-07-story-b1d481.wav.text: It's what your heart holds on to.

s05-08-talk-aecfca.wav.text: That means none of us can say we've kept this one perfectly.

s06-03-story-fadb29.wav.text: She had broken this commandment, and they wanted her punished.

s06-04-story-32e9d5.wav.text: Jesus said the one without sin should throw the first stone.

s06-05-story-942954.wav.text: And one by one, they all walked away.

s06-07-grave-86f365.wav.text: Neither do I condemn you; go, and from now on sin no more.

s06-08-talk-89f5a6.wav.text: He didn't say it was nothing.

s07-01-talk-15ba47.wav.text: That's the seventh commandment in the end.

s07-02-story-1d3935.wav.text: Keep your promises, because God keeps his.
